framework: open-universe research framework for a sole conditional rolling 5% total-return objective; implementation remains blocked

strategy_controls.current_state: no model-approved market allocation; no account balance, actual holding or cash destination is inferred
strategy_controls.research_universe_policy: open T1 research universe across lawful and account-accessible direct equities, ETFs/funds, public REITs, sovereign and cash products; T2/T3/T4 remain finite and gated
strategy_controls.cash_accounting_policy: settled distributions are recorded once only within total-return accounting; sales, unrealized changes, external flows and unsettled receivables remain distinct; return-of-capital-like components are separately flagged and handled under a predeclared ledger convention
strategy_controls.cash_disposition_policy: investor_directed_no_default_use; retaining, withdrawing or later considering a new allocation does not change prior total-return accounting; no automatic reinvestment, mandatory retention or target-repair deployment is permitted
strategy_controls.return_range_policy: 5% is a rolling five-year annualized TWRR research objective, not a calendar-year floor, prediction or probability claim
strategy_controls.return_evidence_policy: data/return_evidence_20260812.json status fail/not_run/blocked; no implementation until a reproducible point-in-time replay and B0/B1 benchmarks pass independent review
strategy_controls.risk_budget_policy: data/risk_budget_20260812.json status not_approved; the retired fixed vector's -25.00% planning stress rejects preset weights and a frozen T2 candidate portfolio must pass a new risk budget before q_portfolio can change
strategy_controls.execution_eligibility_policy: data/execution_eligibility_policy_20260812.json; status not_run and q=0 until current-session fields pass
strategy_controls.fallback_policy: failed or missing eligibility removes model market-allocation permission; eligible protected liquidity is a conditional fallback category, while actual cash use remains investor-directed; no automatic high-yield substitution, forced REIT activation or catch-up allocation
strategy_controls.observed_drawdown_policy: only documented external-flow-adjusted DD_t can trigger -12% caution lock and -18% mandatory risk stop
strategy_controls.performance_measurement: strategy TWRR plus investor MWRR/XIRR; external flows create subperiod breaks; distributions are counted once only within total return

pass_conditions: All material claims resolve to a locally archived primary source and state a limitation.
The report distinguishes the literal annual-floor request from rolling research objectives and does not make a guarantee claim.

The framework is scale-neutral; total-return measurement reconciles distributions, costs and external flows without double counting and distinguishes accounting from investor-directed cash disposition.
No standalone cash-receipt target, cash-rate threshold, coverage formula, cash hit-rate or cash-target failure rule remains in the active framework.
No public-REIT candidate is admitted to T3/T4 without project-level valuation/operating/liquidity/correlation validation and a portfolio-level common-risk review.
The return-evidence and risk-budget blockers are reader-facing; q=0 and protected-liquidity fallback are explicit.
No direct equity issuer is named or approved; each future T3 direct equity requires a current-price valuation package before it can enter portfolio review.
Current TeX, PDF, text, render, visual review and review records have matching identities.
A strategic case may publish only as RESEARCH_FRAMEWORK_PASS with IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_APPROVED and zero open S/A findings within its research-framework scope.
downgrade_path: research framework -> evidence-only strategy memo; never implementation authorization without independent gates
